# Global instructions

## Writing

- Write short sentences in active voice.
- Use one instruction for each sentence.
- Do not use en dashes or em dashes. Use a comma, a colon, or a plain hyphen.

## Tools

- Use `uv run` for Python. Do not use pip.
- Do not delete files. Move them to the Trash.

## Tests

- Prefer end-to-end tests. Do not write unit tests after the code.
- At the end of an end-to-end test, keep a repeatable artifact as proof.

## Skills

- Before you write prose, apply the `@~/.claude/skills/unslop/SKILL.md` rules. This is a code span, not an import.

# Project instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) first. It names the files to read for each task.

No tests in this project. Do not write, run, or keep tests. Prove work with a real run on the data.

# Neighbourhood pages

URL `/<country>/<city>/<area>/`. Route and content `frontend/src/pages/[country]/[slug]/[area].astro`.
About 4,900 pages are built. About 2,960 are in the sitemap. The rest are `noindex`.

## Current state (2026-10-18)

- Index rule: `noindex` when the area is low data, has fewer than 5 groups, or has fewer than 300 classified names.
- These pages carry about 90% of all impressions, from bare place-name queries, at a 0.16% click rate.
- A one-zone city shows its polygon as plain text, with no self-link.

## Decisions

| Date | Decision | Why | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-03 | No self-link from a one-zone city to an area page. | The route builder skips that page. | first-iteration/docs/NOW.md |
| 2026-10-06 | Add `noindex` for areas under 300 classified names. No mass `noindex`. | A 30% share then has a margin near 5 points. A sudden cut of 3,000 URLs is a risk. | first-iteration/seo/hard-truths-plan.md, task 4 |
| 2026-10-18 | Keep the index rule as it is for the whole iteration. | These pages are the only ones search engines show today. | second-iteration/plan.md |

## Open

- Few next steps to nearby areas on the page. Decide after traffic data exists.

## See also

- [city.md](city.md): City pages. Each area page links back to its city.

# Frontend rules

These rules apply to work in `frontend/`.

@./DESIGN.md

- Read [README.md](README.md), section "Design and display rules", before you change a component.
- Use `npm --prefix frontend run build` to check a change. There are no tests.
- Use the tokens in `src/styles/global.css`. Do not add raw colors in components.
- Do not change URLs, titles, H1, or intros before the 3 November reading.
- After a page change, add a row to its file in [../second-iteration/decisions/](../second-iteration/decisions/index.md).
